[Intro]
[Cm]  [Ab]
[Cm]  [Bb]
[Cm]  [Ab]
[Cm][Bb]Fall
[Cm]  [Ab]
[Cm]  [Bb]
[Ab]  [Absus2]
[Fsus2]  [Bb]  [Db]  [Bb]

[Verse 1]
[Cm]Now the dark begins
to rise
[Ab/C]Save your breath, it's far
[Bb]from over
[Cm]Leave the lost and dead
behind
[Ab/C]Now's your chance to run
[Bb]for cover
[Cm]I don't want to change
the world
[Ab/C]I just wanna leave
[Bb]it colder
[Cm]Light the fuse and burn
it up
[Ab/C]Take the path that leads
[Bb]to nowhere

[Pre-Chorus]
[Ab]All is lost again
[Bb]But
[Ab]I'm not giving in
[Bb]I will not

[Chorus]
[Cm]bow I will not
[Bb]break I will shut
[Absus2]the world away
I will not
[Cm]fall I will not
[Bb]fade I will take
[Absus2]your breath away
Fall

[Bridge]
[Cm]  [Ab]
[Cm]  [Bb]
[Ab]  [Absus2]
[Fsus2]  [Bb]  [Db]  [Bb]

[Verse 2]
[Cm]Watch the end through dy-
ing eyes
[Ab/C]Now the dark is ta-
[Bb]king over
[Cm]Show me where fore-
ver dies
[Ab/C]Take the fall and run
[Bb]to Heaven

[Pre-Chorus]
[Ab]All is lost again
[Bb]But
[Ab]I'm not giving in
[Bb]I will not

[Chorus]
[Cm]bow I will not
[Bb]break I will shut
[Absus2]the world away
I will not
[Cm]fall I will not
[Bb]fade I will take
[Absus2]your breath away
And I'll survive,
[Cm]paranoid
[Bb]I have lost
[Absus2]the will to change
And I am not
[Cm]proud, coldblooded
[Bb]fake I will shut
[Absus2]the world away

[Solo]
[Cm]
Open your
[C5]eyes! [Eb5][C5][Gb5][F5][Db5]
[C5]  [Eb5]  [C5]

[Absus2]the world away
I will not

[Bb]fake I will shut
[Absus2]the world away
[Eb5][Bb5]Fall!

[Cm]  [Db]

title: I Will Not Bow
